profile.headline: Tech Lead and Staff Software Engineer at GA-I3

positions.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead for portfolio of programs deploying situational awareness software to edge customers for UAVs
- Integrate new commercial data and payload feeds into common operating picture for mission operators
- Manage technical schedule, architecture, and implementation direction for portfolio projects
- Represent GA-I3 in meetings with government
- Supervise team of engineers, providing mentoring, tasking, and performance assessments

positions.title: Senior Principal Systems Engineer
positions.description: Modeling and Simulation role on ICBM payload team. Design, implement, and optimize modeling products for program.

positions.title: Sr. Principal Systems Engineer - SEA Program
positions.description:
Northrop Grumman leadership development program to mature systems engineering aptitude in promising engineers.
Highlights:
Shaped customer requirements for large classified acquisition by leading mission level simulation studies. Integrated 10 GB/day of data products with Tableau dashboards for deeper insight.

Prototyped embedded Kubernetes architecture for satellite payload processing. Provided reference architecture for follow on programs. 

Lead development of satellite sensor planning software. Modeled system performance and
initiated interface with mission level planning algorithm.

positions.title: Principal Investigator, IRAD Project
positions.description: Lead a team of 5 software engineers developing simulation of Ground Based Strategic Deterrent communications network. Solicit further investment of $3.5 million from Northrop Grumman to accelerate schedule and expand role of simulation to integration and test stimulator during EMD contract.

certifications.name: edX Verified Certificate for Introduction to Kubernetes

publications.title: Design of a High Elevation Impact Sampling Tool (HEIST) for Study of Atmospheric Microbes
